name: Casa Cattle Company
old_description: Our family farm strives to provide the best to all of our customers.
about:
Casa Cattle Company operates as a family farm in Corinna, Maine. The business is owned and operated by Jesse, Corinna, Ashton, and Abby, who oversee the production of genetics, breed stock, and all-natural beef and pork. A founding year is not publicly disclosed.

The farm supplies cattle genetics and breed stock to other producers while also raising livestock for all-natural beef and pork. Operations cover breeding, selection, and meat production, though specific facility size, herd numbers, or annual output are not published.

Customers include other livestock operations seeking genetics and breed stock, as well as buyers of all-natural meat products. The company does not specify particular industries or named accounts.

The owners state they strive to provide the best to every customer, emphasizing hard work to please those who purchase their genetics, breed stock, or meat. No further differentiation claims are made.
